question: Which goddess in the nine-syllable formula is identified as the giver of supreme truth?
premises: The context is the nine-syllable formula.
Kālikā is called Dakṣiṇā in this context.
She is described as the giver of supreme truth.
inference: In the nine-syllable formula, Dakṣiṇā Kālikā is the giver of supreme truth.
plain_english: In the nine-syllable formula, Kālikā, called Dakṣiṇā, is the giver of the supreme truth.
